# Dayan Agent Skills

> Open skills, harnesses, hooks, and verifiers for making probabilistic AI work more repeatable, inspectable, and human-friendly.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills
Live Dayan Deck demo: https://kosmoray.github.io/dayan-agent-skills/
License: MIT
Release: 1.7.2-beta.1

## Available Skills

- 56 installable public beta Skills are listed in catalog.json.
- Dayan Deck: turns structured content into a self-contained HTML presentation with one narrative job per slide, a coherent visual system, editable text, and a deterministic structural verifier.
- Dayan Wenzhen: turns a vague or risky request into a falsifiable problem hypothesis and minimal task contract.
- Dayan Adversarial Reviewer: reviews a bounded engineering change through failure-mode, maintainability, and trust-boundary lenses, then returns evidence-backed Markdown and machine-verifiable JSON.

## Start Here

- docs/quickstart.md: temporary-home install and verifier path.
- docs/choose-a-skill.md: choose the first Skill by failure mode.
- docs/core-knowledge.md: public-safe map of broader method candidates and publication boundaries.
- docs/control-layer-vs-prompt-collection.md: why this repository is a control library rather than a prompt collection.
- docs/demos/control-library.html: one-screen visual comparison of a prompt collection and a control library.
- docs/share-kit.md: bounded public sharing copy, approved facts, non-claims, and social-card link.
- docs/tooling.md: public catalog of local repository tools and what each proves.
- docs/playbooks/README.md: applied public methods.
- examples/runs/README.md: 11 sanitized copy-paste example runs.
- docs/fixtures/README.md: 12 copyable artifact fixtures.
- docs/methods.md: 15 compact public method cards.
- docs/good-first-issues.md: 8 bounded contribution tasks.
- scripts/compatibility_smoke.py: clean temporary-home install smoke report.
- docs/compatibility-matrix.json: machine-readable all-Skill package install matrix.
- scripts/runtime_smoke.py: offline lifecycle smoke for discovery, trigger routing, example commands, non-trigger rejection, and safe update.
- docs/runtime-smoke.json: machine-readable all-Skill offline lifecycle matrix.

## Verified

- catalog and plugin manifests parse;
- thirty positive and negative tests pass;
- isolated packaging into Codex and Claude Code Skill directories passes;
- flagship examples pass their deterministic verifiers;
- public redline scanning is part of CI.
- public example runs are checked by scripts/verify_examples.py.
- public artifact fixtures are checked by scripts/verify_fixtures.py.
- public method cards are checked by scripts/verify_methods.py.
- public positioning is checked by scripts/verify_positioning.py.
- one-screen control demo is checked by scripts/verify_control_demo.py.
- share kit and social card are checked by scripts/verify_share_kit.py.
- good-first issues are checked by scripts/verify_good_first_issues.py.
- public tooling docs are checked by scripts/verify_tooling.py.
- compatibility smoke is checked by scripts/compatibility_smoke.py.
- all-Skill compatibility matrix reports 112 clean package install passes.
- runtime smoke is checked by scripts/runtime_smoke.py.
- all-Skill runtime smoke reports 112 offline lifecycle passes.

## Not claimed

- universal behavioral compatibility across host or model versions;
- verified PPTX export;
- visual quality from structural tests alone;
- suitability for consequential decisions without human review.

## Roadmap

Next evidence wave: runtime trigger reports, clean external compatibility reports, stronger generated artifact fixtures, and narrower method-specific verifiers.
